annotations.title: Route a situation to the right guides and stacks

description: Pick the 1 to 3 situations that fit the user and get the guides and stacks to read for each. Choose the ids yourself from what the user said; never send their words, which stay with you. The standard starting set is always included. Open a result with dp_get_guide or dp_get_stack. For a keyword lookup use dp_search instead. Situations: new-to-privacy (I'm new to privacy and don't know where to start); work-or-business (I work from home or run a business); journalist-or-activist (I report, research or organise); harassment (Someone is watching or harassing me); car-data (My car is sharing how I drive); family-location (I want to share location with my family); leave-google (I want to leave Google); phone (I am choosing or changing my phone); browser (I want a more private browser); accounts (I want better accounts and logins); network (I want to fix my home network or VPN); being-recorded (Someone is recording me); street-cameras (Cameras are watching my street); ai (I want to use AI more privately); smart-tv (My TV is tracking what I watch); clear-online (I want to clear what is already online).

situations.description: 1 to 3 situation ids, best fit first.
